instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-05_input.step. Keep the circular flange outside diameter 148 mm and thickness 18 mm. Cut a center through hole of diameter 44 mm. On a bolt circle radius of 54 mm, cut eight through holes every 45 degrees starting on +X. The holes at 0, 90, 180, and 270 degrees are diameter 8 mm and have bottom counterbores of diameter 16 mm and depth 5 mm. The holes at 45, 135, 225, and 315 degrees are diameter 10 mm and have top counterbores of diameter 18 mm and depth 5 mm. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-05_output.step. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH). For the steps below, use `/usr/lib/freecad/bin/freecadcmd-python3` for the FreeCAD command-line work in this task when working on `freecad_task-05_input.step`.
